entities.name: Query aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: 343 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 37.6 kDa and theoretical pI 5.10.
Strong homology to reviewed aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases: 50.0–55.5% identity across 97.7–98.0% of the sequence; best E-value 1.16e-117.
Pfam domains Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118) at residues 6–118 and Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774) at residues 137–324.
Likely cytosolic homodimeric NADPH-dependent enzyme in aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthesis.
Functional assignment is supported by homology and domain evidence; exact biochemical activity remains computationally inferred for this sequence.

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde reaction
observations: EC 1.2.1.11; Rhea RHEA:24284. L-Aspartyl-4-phosphate is reductively dephosphorylated to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde using NADPH, producing phosphate and NADP+.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme occupies the second step of pathways leading from L-aspartate toward lysine, methionine, threonine, and in some organisms arginine biosynthesis.

entities.name: O67716
observations: Reviewed Aquifex aeolicus aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase; 55.5% identity and 97.7% query coverage to the query sequence; annotated EC 1.2.1.11 and homodimeric.

entities.name: Q04797
observations: Reviewed Bacillus subtilis aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase; 52.4% identity and 98.0% query coverage to the query sequence; annotated EC 1.2.1.11 and homodimeric.
